name: beevvy
description: Run your Beevvy business loyalty program from ChatGPT: missions, rewards, follower segments, announcements, campaigns and growth analytics.

interface.longDescription:
Beevvy helps independent businesses grow with missions, rewards and their local community. With the Beevvy plugin, business owners can run their whole loyalty program from a conversation.

What you can do:
- See how your business is doing: new followers, mission completions, reward redemptions and points over any date range.
- Create, edit, pause or close missions (for example "check in 3 times, earn 100 points") and review submissions waiting for approval.
- Create and update rewards, vouchers and discounts, and see who redeemed what.
- Understand your followers by segment (active, new, cooling, dormant, top spenders) and tag them.
- Preview an announcement before sending it, then send, schedule, A/B test or recall it within 15 minutes.
- Set up multi-step campaigns and Smart Automations such as welcome, birthday and win-back messages.
- Measure revenue attribution, customer lifetime value and monthly cohorts when a store is connected.

Who it is for: business owners and teams with a Beevvy business account. Regular Beevvy members can read their profile, notifications and message threads.

Limitations: every action runs as the signed-in Beevvy user, with Beevvy's access rules enforced, so you only ever see and change your own business data. Beevvy does not process payments or transfer money from ChatGPT. Sending an announcement or campaign notifies real followers, so ChatGPT confirms the audience with you first and offers a dry-run preview.
defaultPrompt: How did my business do on Beevvy this week?
Show my active Beevvy missions and how they are performing.
Which of my Beevvy followers are cooling off?

positive.description: Weekly performance summary for the signed-in business
positive.prompt: How did my business do on Beevvy over the last 7 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the test business's new followers, participations, mission completions, redemptions, points awarded and points spent for the last 7 days, summarized in plain language. No data from other businesses is shown.

positive.prompt: Show my active missions and how many people completed each one.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the active missions seeded in the test account (title, reward, deadline) with participants, completions and completion rate for each.

positive.prompt: Create a mission called Coffee Lover: check in 3 times this month and earn 100 points. It should end on December 31.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an active mission titled Coffee Lover with a 100 points reward and a December 31 deadline, then confirms the created mission's details back to the user.

positive.prompt: How many followers would receive an announcement titled Weekend Sale saying we have 20 percent off this Saturday? Don't send it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the recipient count and the breakdown by segment (active, new, cooling, dormant) without sending anything, and states clearly that nothing was sent.

positive.prompt: Break down my followers by segment and tell me which group I should re-engage first.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows total followers and counts for active, new, cooling, dormant, never redeemed and top spenders, with the segment definitions, and suggests focusing on the cooling or dormant group based on the numbers.

negative.description: Payments and money transfers are not supported
negative.prompt: Send 200 euros to my top customer as a thank-you.

negative.description: Access to another business's data is not allowed
negative.prompt: Show me the followers and rewards of Cafe Luna, the business next door.

negative.description: Unrelated request outside Beevvy scope: Beevvy must not call any of its tools
negative.prompt: Book me a table for two at an Italian restaurant in Munich tonight.

review.commerce_description: Beevvy does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT. Rewards are loyalty points and vouchers redeemed in the Beevvy app.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: analytics, missions, rewards, follower segments, announcements, campaigns and Smart Automations for Beevvy business accounts.

de-DE.subtitle: Treue, Missionen, Prämien
de-DE.description: Beevvy hilft unabhängigen Unternehmen, mit Missionen, Prämien und ihrer lokalen Community zu wachsen. Mit dem Beevvy-Plugin steuern Geschäftsinhaber ihr gesamtes Treueprogramm direkt im Chat: Kennzahlen ansehen, Missionen und Prämien erstellen, Follower segmentieren, Ankündigungen vorab prüfen, senden oder planen sowie Kampagnen und Smart Automations einrichten. Jede Aktion läuft als angemeldeter Beevvy-Nutzer, du siehst und änderst also nur die Daten deines eigenen Unternehmens.

fr-FR.subtitle: Missions et récompenses
fr-FR.description: Beevvy aide les commerces indépendants à grandir grâce aux missions, aux récompenses et à leur communauté locale. Avec le plugin Beevvy, les commerçants pilotent tout leur programme de fidélité depuis une conversation : statistiques, missions, récompenses, segments d'abonnés, annonces avec aperçu avant envoi, campagnes et Smart Automations. Chaque action s'exécute avec le compte Beevvy connecté : vous ne voyez et ne modifiez que les données de votre propre commerce.
